info.name: AFG POS QA | AUTO RECOVERY B1-B6 | CLEANING GUARD FIXED V8
info.description:
QA staging only. Run collection once. qa_recovery_execute=false for read-only; true for verified QA simulated payment. All writes gated by verified session/order and explicit opt-in. Multiple orders and inconsistent sessions remain BLOCKED; see qrc_Bx_block_reason. Not a substitute for backend fixes.
V7: B2 recovery handles up to 8 active orders by inspecting live table/session on each pass, processing one at a time. If more than 8 remain, FINAL VERIFY FAILS. This can create simulated payments. qa_recovery_execute=false by default. Do not use on production or shared active customer tables.

exec: console.warn('If execute=true, this workflow may create QA orders and simulated payments; verify staging gateway before RUN.');

item.name: B1 01 DISCOVER session and existing orders

exec: // Find live table ID from previously snapshotted tables.

else{pm.environment.set('qrc_B1_needs_create','true');console.log('B1 OPEN session with no orders, new QA order needed');}
